verdict.rationale: React's official docs recommend full-stack frameworks for building entire apps, namely Next.js or React Router [react-docs-4]. They describe Next.js App Router as taking full advantage of React's architecture [react-docs-21], with server data fetching in async components [react-docs-7] and per-route SSR [react-docs-45]. However, these are endorsed ecosystem frameworks rather than a meta-framework React itself ships, so 'official' is only met through endorsement. Missing for 10: a first-party React meta-framework, and React-hosted documentation of its routing and data-fetching APIs.
